description_en: Creates a GCS file import task
description_zh: 创建GCP Cloud Storage文件导入任务
kebab_example: aliyun sls create-gcs-ingestion --project ali-test-project --description test --display-name test --configuration example-string --name test --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateGCSIngestion

fields.help_en: The name of the destination logstore
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The access key ID for authenticating with the GCS service. This parameter is required
fields.name: access_key_id

fields.help_en: The secret access key corresponding to the `accessKeyId`. This value is sensitive and must be managed securely
fields.name: access_key_secret

fields.help_en: A nested object for specifying advanced configuration options as key-value pairs
fields.name: advanced_parameters

fields.help_en: The name of the GCS bucket that contains the source data files
fields.name: bucket

fields.help_en: The compression format of the source files. Supported values are `none`, `gzip`, and `zstd`. If not specified, the system infers the format from the file extension
fields.name: compression_codec

fields.help_en: The character encoding of the source files. The default value is `UTF-8`
fields.name: encoding

fields.help_en: The end of the time range for data ingestion, specified as a Unix timestamp (in seconds). Only objects modified before this time are ingested
fields.help_zh: 某个时间点前修改过的文件
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The service endpoint for GCS. You can use a custom endpoint for private or accelerated connections
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en: A nested object that defines the format of the source data, such as CSV, JSON, or Parquet
fields.name: format

fields.help_en: The interval for checking for new data. Specify the value in a duration format, such as `15m` for 15 minutes. Set to `never` to perform a one-time ingestion
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: A regular expression that specifies which files to ingest. The pattern is matched against the full object key within the specified prefix
fields.name: pattern

fields.help_en: The object key prefix used to discover files. This limits the scope of ingestion to a specific "folder" within the bucket
fields.name: prefix

fields.help_en: The unique ID of the processor or pipeline that handles the ingested data
fields.name: processor_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically restore objects from archival storage classes before ingestion. Set to `true` to enable this feature. The default is `false`
fields.name: restore_object_enabled

fields.help_en: The start of the time range for data ingestion, specified as a Unix timestamp (in seconds). Only objects modified at or after this time are ingested
fields.help_zh: 某个时间点后修改过的文件
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en: The ID of a predefined tag pack to apply to the ingested data. Tag packs contain rules for data enrichment and categorization
fields.name: tag_pack_id

fields.help_en: The name of the field in your data that contains the timestamp. This timestamp is used as the event time for the ingested records
fields.name: time_field

fields.help_en: The format of the timestamp in the `timeField`, specified using the Java `SimpleDateFormat` pattern. For example: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`
fields.name: time_format

fields.help_en: A regular expression used to extract a timestamp from unstructured data, such as a log entry or filename, if a structured `timeField` is not available
fields.name: time_pattern

fields.help_en: The time zone for parsing timestamps that lack explicit time zone information. Specify a valid time zone identifier, such as `UTC` or `America/Los_Angeles`
fields.name: time_zone

fields.help_en: Specifies the configuration for ingesting data from a Google Cloud Storage (GCS) data source
fields.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The job name. Must be unique within the same project. Naming rules:

Can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

Must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit.

Must be 2 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
作业名称。其命名规则如下：

同一个 Project 下，作业的名称不可重复。

只能包括小写字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾。
长度为 2-64 字符
parameters.name: name

schema.title_en: 是否长链接。取值包括：  close：不是长链接，则每个HTTP请求都会重新建立TCP连接。 keep-alive：长链接，TCP连接建立后保持连接状态，节省连接所需时间和带宽。
schema.title_zh: 是否长链接。取值包括：  close：不是长链接，则每个HTTP请求都会重新建立TCP连接。 keep-alive：长链接，TCP连接建立后保持连接状态，节省连接所需时间和带宽。

schema.title_zh: 返回的响应体的内容格式

schema.title_en: 服务端产生的标识，该请求的唯一ID。
schema.title_zh: 服务端产生的标识，该请求的唯一ID。
